detail: CME's FAQ wording does not say explicitly whether MET receives ETH's settlement PRICE (as MBT receives BTC's, CRYPTO-7) or runs the same PROCEDURE on MET's own trades; the sentence answers 'How is the Micro Ether futures daily settlement price determined?' and then describes the ETH contract's VWAP only, which reads as settling to ETH's price. Ambiguity flagged; the lead decides. A search summary of CME's client wiki also says MET matches ETH [snippet].
quote: How is the Micro Ether futures daily settlement price determined? Daily settlement for Micro Ether futures will be the same as Ether futures. The daily settlement of the Ether futures contract is based on the volume-weighted average price (VWAP) of CME Globex trades between 3:59:00 p.m. and 4:00:00 p.m. ET.

value: MBT's information share approximately equal to or slightly greater than BTC's (Hasbrouck IS and Lien-Shrestha modified IS); exact shares not in abstract
window: intraday; period not in abstract (MBT launched 2021-05-03; published 2022)
detail: Pati (2022), 'Informativeness of CME Micro Bitcoin Futures in Pricing of Bitcoin: Intraday Evidence', Finance Research Letters 49, 103084 (peer-reviewed). Abstract only (IDEAS). Relevant to the Sat (iii) test: on this abstract MBT is not attributed 75% or more of discovery to BTC (approximately equal), but no number is given. Full text paywalled.
quote: Hasbrouck's information share, and Lien and Shrestha's modified information share suggest that MBT contributes approximately equal or slightly greater proportion to price discovery with BTC. The dominance of MBT is marginally higher in Bitstamp and itBit compared to Coinbase and Kraken.

value: Bitcoin futures dominate price discovery relative to spot; CBOE futures led CME's
window: period surrounding the Dec 2017 futures launches (high-frequency data)
detail: Akyildirim, Corbet, Katsiampa, Kellard and Sensoy (2020), 'The development of Bitcoin futures: exploring the interactions between cryptocurrency derivatives', Finance Research Letters (peer-reviewed).
